title: User Login Authentication
description: Users authenticate with email and password. System validates credentials and creates a session.
acceptance_criteria: Valid login redirects to dashboard; Invalid shows error; Account locks after 5 fails

title: Password Reset via Email
description: Forgotten password reset via email link. Link expires after 24 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Email delivered in 60s; Link valid 24h; Link one-time use

title: User Registration
description: New users register with name, email, and password. Email verification required.
acceptance_criteria: Email must be unique; Password meets complexity; Verification email sent

title: Product Search
description: Users can search products by keyword, category, price range, and rating.
acceptance_criteria: Search returns relevant results; Filters work correctly; Results paginated

title: Shopping Cart Management
description: Users can add, update quantity, and remove items from their shopping cart.
acceptance_criteria: Cart persists across sessions; Quantity updates reflect in totals; Items can be removed
